entry.title: Great Consensus Cleanup Revival
entry.summary:
The complete set of BIP54 modifications has now been integrated into libbitcoin. Details and the implementation can be found in the pull request at [https://github.com/libbitcoin/libbitcoin-system/pull/2149](https://github.com/libbitcoin/libbitcoin-system/pull/2149). This advancement marks a significant step towards aligning libbitcoin with the latest standards outlined in BIP54.
Thorough review and testing of these changes remain as next steps to ensure their accuracy and reliability. This process involves scrutinizing both the libbitcoin implementation and comparable code within Bitcoin Core, aiming to identify any potential logical inconsistencies. Such comprehensive validation efforts are essential for building trust and confidence in the robustness of the BIP54 integration.
